spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m6p2t0 ----
\* A university course-registration system holds a fixed number of seats for one course and leases
\* them to students under time-limited holds. Enrolling a student takes a free seat and charges the
\* hold to full span; renewing extends it, dropping returns the seat, and a hold left to decay lapses
\* and returns the seat. A student may crash silently and then cannot enroll again until it recovers,
\* though any seat it already holds survives until its hold lapses. Free seats plus held seats always
\* add up to the fixed total: seats are only ever moved between free and held, never created or lost.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Students == {"s1", "s2"}
TOTAL == 2
Span == 2

VARIABLES freeSeats, enrolled, hold, crashed

TypeOK ==
  /\ freeSeats \in 0..TOTAL
  /\ enrolled \in SUBSET Students
  /\ hold \in [Students -> 0..Span]
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Students

Init ==
  /\ freeSeats = TOTAL
  /\ enrolled = {}
  /\ hold = [s \in Students |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}

Enroll(s) ==
  /\ s \notin enrolled
  /\ s \notin crashed
  /\ freeSeats > 0
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {s}
  /\ freeSeats' = freeSeats - 1
  /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Renew(s) ==
  /\ s \in enrolled
  /\ hold[s] > 0
  /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<freeSeats, enrolled, crashed>>

Drop(s) ==
  /\ s \in enrolled
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {s}
  /\ freeSeats' = freeSeats + 1
  /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Decay(s) ==
  /\ s \in enrolled
  /\ hold[s] > 1
  /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = hold[s] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<freeSeats, enrolled, crashed>>

Lapse(s) ==
  /\ s \in enrolled
  /\ hold[s] = 1
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {s}
  /\ freeSeats' = freeSeats + 1
  /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(s) ==
  /\ s \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<freeSeats, enrolled, hold>>

Recover(s) ==
  /\ s \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<freeSeats, enrolled, hold>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Students : Enroll(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Renew(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Drop(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Decay(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Lapse(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Crash(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Recover(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<freeSeats, enrolled, hold, crashed>>

SeatsConserved ==
  freeSeats + Cardinality(enrolled) = TOTAL
====
nl:
A university course-registration system holds a fixed number of seats for one course and leases them to students under time-limited holds. Enrolling takes a free seat, marks the student enrolled, and charges the hold to its full span, but only for a student that has not crashed. Renewing extends a hold to full span. Dropping returns a seat and clears the hold. A hold decays a step at a time and, when it reaches its last tick, lapses and returns the seat. A student may crash silently, after which it cannot enroll until it recovers, though any seat it already holds remains until that hold lapses.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of free seats plus the number of enrolled students always equals the fixed total, so seats are only ever moved between free and held and never created or lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m7p3t1 ----
\* A pharmacy prescription dispenser assigns drawers to patients through a compare-and-swap register
\* per drawer. Claim requests may arrive reordered, held in a small unordered pool; each request reads
\* a drawer's current version and names a patient. A claim commits only when both the drawer and the
\* patient are free and the request's read version still equals the drawer's live version, recording the
\* drawer on the patient and the patient on the drawer and bumping the version; a request whose read has
\* gone stale is dropped. Releasing frees both and bumps the version. The drawer-to-patient and
\* patient-to-drawer records stay exact inverses, so a drawer is never assigned to two patients.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Drawers == {"k1", "k2"}
Patients == {"p1", "p2"}
MaxVer == 2
PoolCap == 2

VARIABLES drawerPat, patDrawer, dver, pool

Req == [drw: Drawers, exp: 0..MaxVer, pat: Patients]

TypeOK ==
  /\ drawerPat \in [Drawers -> Patients \cup {NONE}]
  /\ patDrawer \in [Patients -> Drawers \cup {NONE}]
  /\ dver \in [Drawers -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ pool \in SUBSET Req

Init ==
  /\ drawerPat = [k \in Drawers |-> NONE]
  /\ patDrawer = [p \in Patients |-> NONE]
  /\ dver = [k \in Drawers |-> 0]
  /\ pool = {}

Submit(k, p) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pool) < PoolCap
  /\ pool' = pool \cup {[drw |-> k, exp |-> dver[k], pat |-> p]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<drawerPat, patDrawer, dver>>

Claim(m) ==
  /\ m \in pool
  /\ m.exp = dver[m.drw]
  /\ drawerPat[m.drw] = NONE
  /\ patDrawer[m.pat] = NONE
  /\ dver[m.drw] < MaxVer
  /\ drawerPat' = [drawerPat EXCEPT ![m.drw] = m.pat]
  /\ patDrawer' = [patDrawer EXCEPT ![m.pat] = m.drw]
  /\ dver' = [dver EXCEPT ![m.drw] = dver[m.drw] + 1]
  /\ pool' = pool \ {m}

DropStale(m) ==
  /\ m \in pool
  /\ (m.exp # dver[m.drw] \/ dver[m.drw] = MaxVer)
  /\ pool' = pool \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<drawerPat, patDrawer, dver>>

Release(k) ==
  /\ drawerPat[k] # NONE
  /\ dver[k] < MaxVer
  /\ LET p == drawerPat[k] IN
       /\ drawerPat' = [drawerPat EXCEPT ![k] = NONE]
       /\ patDrawer' = [patDrawer EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
       /\ dver' = [dver EXCEPT ![k] = dver[k] + 1]
       /\ UNCHANGED pool

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in Drawers, p \in Patients : Submit(k, p)
  \/ \E m \in pool : Claim(m)
  \/ \E m \in pool : DropStale(m)
  \/ \E k \in Drawers : Release(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<drawerPat, patDrawer, dver, pool>>

InverseMaps ==
  \A k \in Drawers, p \in Patients : (drawerPat[k] = p) <=> (patDrawer[p] = k)
====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser assigns drawers to patients through a per-drawer compare-and-swap register. Claim requests may arrive reordered and are held in a small unordered pool bounded in size; each request reads a drawer's current version and names a patient. A claim commits only when the drawer and the patient are both free and the request's read version still equals the drawer's live version, at which point it records the drawer on the patient and the patient on the drawer and bumps the drawer's version. A request whose read version no longer matches, or whose drawer is at its maximum version, is dropped. Releasing a drawer frees both it and its patient and bumps the version.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A drawer records a patient exactly when that patient records that drawer, so a drawer is never assigned to two patients at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m4p3t2 ----
\* An air-traffic runway allocator run by two allocator instances that share one pool of runways
\* assigns flights to runways off a bounded request queue with backpressure. Allocating takes the head
\* flight, moves it onto a free runway, and records both the runway's flight and the flight's runway,
\* stamping which instance made the assignment. A flight may be reassigned to another free runway, and
\* releasing frees a flight's runway. The runway-to-flight and flight-to-runway records are held as
\* exact inverses, so a runway is never assigned to two flights at once.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

NONE == "none"
Flights == {"f1", "f2"}
Runways == {"y1", "y2"}
Instances == {"a", "b"}
QCap == 2

VARIABLES rwFlight, flightRw, queue, allocBy

TypeOK ==
  /\ rwFlight \in [Runways -> Flights \cup {NONE}]
  /\ flightRw \in [Flights -> Runways \cup {NONE}]
  /\ queue \in Seq(Flights)
  /\ allocBy \in [Runways -> Instances \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ rwFlight = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
  /\ flightRw = [f \in Flights |-> NONE]
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ allocBy = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]

Enqueue(f) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ flightRw[f] = NONE
  /\ ~\E k \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[k] = f
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, f)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rwFlight, flightRw, allocBy>>

Allocate(i, r) ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ rwFlight[r] = NONE
  /\ LET f == Head(queue) IN
       /\ flightRw[f] = NONE
       /\ rwFlight' = [rwFlight EXCEPT ![r] = f]
       /\ flightRw' = [flightRw EXCEPT ![f] = r]
       /\ allocBy' = [allocBy EXCEPT ![r] = i]
       /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

Reassign(i, f, r) ==
  /\ flightRw[f] # NONE
  /\ flightRw[f] # r
  /\ rwFlight[r] = NONE
  /\ rwFlight' = [rwFlight EXCEPT ![flightRw[f]] = NONE, ![r] = f]
  /\ flightRw' = [flightRw EXCEPT ![f] = r]
  /\ allocBy' = [allocBy EXCEPT ![flightRw[f]] = NONE, ![r] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED queue

Release(f) ==
  /\ flightRw[f] # NONE
  /\ LET r == flightRw[f] IN
       /\ rwFlight' = [rwFlight EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
       /\ flightRw' = [flightRw EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
       /\ allocBy' = [allocBy EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
       /\ UNCHANGED queue

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Flights : Enqueue(f)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Runways : Allocate(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, f \in Flights, r \in Runways : Reassign(i, f, r)
  \/ \E f \in Flights : Release(f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<rwFlight, flightRw, queue, allocBy>>

InverseAssign ==
  \A r \in Runways, f \in Flights : (rwFlight[r] = f) <=> (flightRw[f] = r)
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator is run by two allocator instances that share one pool of runways and assign flights off a single bounded request queue with backpressure. A flight is queued while the queue has room, the flight is unassigned, and it is not already queued. Allocating takes the head flight and moves it onto a free runway, recording the runway's flight and the flight's runway and stamping which instance made the assignment. A flight may be reassigned to another free runway, atomically clearing its old runway and taking the new one. Releasing frees a flight's runway.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A runway records a flight exactly when that flight records that runway, so a runway is never assigned to two flights at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m4p5t4 ----
\* A warehouse robot fleet runs pick tasks through a bounded dispatch queue with backpressure. A task
\* is submitted while there is queue room, assigned from the head of the queue to a robot only while the
\* number of active tasks is below the capacity, which changes at runtime, and then either aborted back
\* to new or committed. Committing a pick is irreversible: it moves the task to its terminal done state
\* and records it in the committed ledger, and a done task is never picked again. A task is in the
\* committed ledger exactly when it has reached its done state, so each irreversible pick happens at
\* most once.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Tasks == {"t1", "t2"}
Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
MaxCap == 2
QCap == 2

VARIABLES phase, worker, committed, capacity, queue

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Tasks -> {"new", "active", "done"}]
  /\ worker \in [Tasks -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
  /\ committed \in SUBSET Tasks
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ queue \in Seq(Tasks)

Init ==
  /\ phase = [t \in Tasks |-> "new"]
  /\ worker = [t \in Tasks |-> NONE]
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ queue = << >>

Active == Cardinality({t \in Tasks : phase[t] = "active"})

Submit(t) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ phase[t] = "new"
  /\ ~\E k \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[k] = t
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, worker, committed, capacity>>

Assign(r) ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ Active < capacity
  /\ LET t == Head(queue) IN
       /\ phase[t] = "new"
       /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "active"]
       /\ worker' = [worker EXCEPT ![t] = r]
       /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
       /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, capacity>>

Commit(r, t) ==
  /\ worker[t] = r
  /\ phase[t] = "active"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "done"]
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {t}
  /\ worker' = [worker EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, queue>>

Abort(r, t) ==
  /\ worker[t] = r
  /\ phase[t] = "active"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "new"]
  /\ worker' = [worker EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, capacity, queue>>

AdjustCapacity(c) ==
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, worker, committed, queue>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Tasks : Submit(t)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Assign(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, t \in Tasks : Commit(r, t)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, t \in Tasks : Abort(r, t)
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<phase, worker, committed, capacity, queue>>

CommitCoherent ==
  \A t \in Tasks : (t \in committed) <=> (phase[t] = "done")
====
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet runs pick tasks through a bounded dispatch queue with backpressure. A new task is submitted to the queue while there is room and it is not already queued. Assigning takes the head task and gives it to a robot, moving it to active, but only while the number of active tasks is below the capacity, which is adjusted at runtime. An active task may be aborted back to new, or committed. Committing a pick is irreversible: it moves the task to its terminal done state and records it in the committed ledger, and a done task is never assigned or picked again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A task is in the committed ledger exactly when it has reached its done state, so each irreversible pick happens at most once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m6p5t5 ----
\* An elevator bank leases cars to controllers under time-limited leases. A lease may be renewed, may
\* decay a step at a time, or may lapse and free the car. While a controller holds a car's lease it may
\* commit a dispatch, an irreversible action that moves the car to its terminal dispatched state and
\* records it in the dispatch ledger; a dispatched car is never dispatched again. A privileged admin
\* override may forcibly drop a car's lease. A car is in the dispatch ledger exactly when it is in its
\* dispatched state, so each irreversible dispatch happens at most once.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Cars == {"c1", "c2"}
Controllers == {"o1", "o2"}
Span == 2

VARIABLES leaseHolder, ttl, phase, dispatched

TypeOK ==
  /\ leaseHolder \in [Cars -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
  /\ ttl \in [Cars -> 0..Span]
  /\ phase \in [Cars -> {"idle", "dispatched"}]
  /\ dispatched \in SUBSET Cars

Init ==
  /\ leaseHolder = [c \in Cars |-> NONE]
  /\ ttl = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
  /\ phase = [c \in Cars |-> "idle"]
  /\ dispatched = {}

Lease(o, c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] = NONE
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![c] = o]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, dispatched>>

Renew(o, c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] = o
  /\ ttl[c] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, phase, dispatched>>

Decay(c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] # NONE
  /\ ttl[c] > 1
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = ttl[c] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, phase, dispatched>>

Expire(c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] # NONE
  /\ ttl[c] = 1
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, dispatched>>

Dispatch(o, c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] = o
  /\ phase[c] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "dispatched"]
  /\ dispatched' = dispatched \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, ttl>>

AdminRelease(c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] # NONE
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, dispatched>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Lease(o, c)
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Renew(o, c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Decay(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Expire(c)
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Dispatch(o, c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : AdminRelease(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leaseHolder, ttl, phase, dispatched>>

DispatchOnce ==
  \A c \in Cars : (c \in dispatched) <=> (phase[c] = "dispatched")
====
nl:
An elevator bank leases cars to controllers under time-limited leases. Leasing a free car assigns it to a controller and charges the lease to full span. A lease may be renewed to full span, decays a step at a time, or lapses when it reaches its last tick and frees the car. While a controller holds a car's lease it may commit a dispatch: an irreversible action that moves the car to its terminal dispatched state and records it in the dispatch ledger. A dispatched car is never dispatched again. A privileged admin override may forcibly drop a car's lease at any time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A car is in the dispatch ledger exactly when it is in its dispatched state, so each irreversible dispatch happens at most once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m5p4t2 ----
\* A stock exchange opening auction admits orders to one shared book that two matching instances draw
\* from, using quorum voting. Three replicas vote to admit an order; an order is admitted only once a
\* quorum of replicas backs it and the book is below its capacity, and it is stamped with the instance
\* that admitted it. The capacity changes at runtime but is never lowered below the number already
\* admitted. Admitted orders may be withdrawn, clearing their votes. The number of admitted orders in
\* the book never exceeds the current capacity.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Replicas == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
Orders == {"o1", "o2"}
Instances == {"a", "b"}
Quorum == 2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES admitted, votes, cap, admittedBy

TypeOK ==
  /\ admitted \in SUBSET Orders
  /\ votes \in [Orders -> SUBSET Replicas]
  /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ admittedBy \in [Orders -> Instances \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ admitted = {}
  /\ votes = [o \in Orders |-> {}]
  /\ cap = 1
  /\ admittedBy = [o \in Orders |-> NONE]

Vote(r, o) ==
  /\ o \notin admitted
  /\ r \notin votes[o]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![o] = votes[o] \cup {r}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, cap, admittedBy>>

Admit(i, o) ==
  /\ o \notin admitted
  /\ Cardinality(votes[o]) >= Quorum
  /\ Cardinality(admitted) < cap
  /\ admitted' = admitted \cup {o}
  /\ admittedBy' = [admittedBy EXCEPT ![o] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap>>

Withdraw(o) ==
  /\ o \in admitted
  /\ admitted' = admitted \ {o}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![o] = {}]
  /\ admittedBy' = [admittedBy EXCEPT ![o] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED cap

AdjustCap(c) ==
  /\ c >= Cardinality(admitted)
  /\ cap' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, votes, admittedBy>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Replicas, o \in Orders : Vote(r, o)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, o \in Orders : Admit(i, o)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Withdraw(o)
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCap(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<admitted, votes, cap, admittedBy>>

BookWithinCap ==
  Cardinality(admitted) <= cap
====
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction admits orders to one shared book that two matching instances draw from, using quorum voting. Three replicas may vote to admit an order that is not yet admitted. An order is admitted only once a quorum of replicas backs it and the book holds fewer admitted orders than its capacity, and it is stamped with the instance that admitted it. The capacity is adjusted at runtime but is never lowered below the number of orders already admitted. An admitted order may be withdrawn, which removes it from the book and clears its votes.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of admitted orders in the book never exceeds the current capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m3p2t5 ----
\* An airport baggage router moves a fixed number of bags between an intake and two sorted bins, driven
\* by a single elected leader among two nodes, with leader election and failover. Starting a term clears
\* the leader and votes; a node is elected once both nodes vote for it; the leader crashes on failover.
\* The leader routes a bag from one holding area to another, and a privileged admin override may move a
\* bag directly regardless of the leader. Every move shifts one bag between two holding areas, so the
\* bags across the intake and the two sorted bins always sum to the same fixed total.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Areas == {"intake", "binA", "binB"}
Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
TOTAL == 2
MaxTerm == 2

VARIABLES bags, leader, votedFor, term

TypeOK ==
  /\ bags \in [Areas -> 0..TOTAL]
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
  /\ votedFor \in [Nodes -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
  /\ bags = [a \in Areas |-> IF a = "intake" THEN TOTAL ELSE 0]
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ votedFor = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
  /\ term = 0

StartTerm ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ leader' = NONE
  /\ votedFor' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED bags

Vote(n, cand) ==
  /\ votedFor[n] = NONE
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = cand]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, leader, term>>

Elect(cand) ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : votedFor[n] = cand
  /\ leader' = cand
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, votedFor, term>>

Route(n, src, dst) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ src # dst
  /\ bags[src] > 0
  /\ bags' = [bags EXCEPT ![src] = bags[src] - 1, ![dst] = bags[dst] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, votedFor, term>>

Crash(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ leader' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, votedFor, term>>

AdminMove(src, dst) ==
  /\ src # dst
  /\ bags[src] > 0
  /\ bags' = [bags EXCEPT ![src] = bags[src] - 1, ![dst] = bags[dst] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, votedFor, term>>

Next ==
  \/ StartTerm
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, cand \in Nodes : Vote(n, cand)
  \/ \E cand \in Nodes : Elect(cand)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, src \in Areas, dst \in Areas : Route(n, src, dst)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
  \/ \E src \in Areas, dst \in Areas : AdminMove(src, dst)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<bags, leader, votedFor, term>>

BagsConserved ==
  bags["intake"] + bags["binA"] + bags["binB"] = TOTAL
====
nl:
An airport baggage router moves a fixed number of bags between an intake area and two sorted bins, driven by a single elected leader among two nodes using leader election with failover. Starting a term increments the term and clears the leader and every vote. Each node casts one vote per term while there is no leader, and a node is elected leader once both nodes have voted for it. The leader routes a bag from one holding area to another, shifting one bag at a time. On failover the leader crashes and is cleared. A privileged admin override may move a bag between areas directly, regardless of who leads.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The bags held across the intake and the two sorted bins always sum to the same fixed total, so no bag is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m1p3t1 ----
\* A hospital operating-room scheduler grants theatre slots to surgeries, with a token circling a ring
\* of three schedulers so that only the token holder may commit a booking. Booking requests may arrive
\* reordered and wait in a small unordered pool. The token holder books a slot for a surgery only while
\* the slot is free, recording the slot's surgery and marking the slot booked. Releasing frees the slot
\* and clears its booked mark. A slot is marked booked exactly when it holds a surgery, so a free slot
\* is only ever granted once and never double-allocated.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Surgeries == {"g1", "g2"}
Slots == {"a1", "a2"}
Schedulers == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
PoolCap == 2

VARIABLES slotOf, booked, pool, token

Nxt == [s1 |-> "s2", s2 |-> "s3", s3 |-> "s1"]
Req == [surg: Surgeries, slot: Slots]

TypeOK ==
  /\ slotOf \in [Slots -> Surgeries \cup {NONE}]
  /\ booked \in [Slots -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ pool \in SUBSET Req
  /\ token \in Schedulers

Init ==
  /\ slotOf = [a \in Slots |-> NONE]
  /\ booked = [a \in Slots |-> FALSE]
  /\ pool = {}
  /\ token = "s1"

Submit(g, a) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pool) < PoolCap

PassToken(s) ==
  /\ token = s
  /\ token' = Nxt[s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOf, booked, pool>>

Book(s, m) ==

  /\ m \in pool

  /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, token>>

---- MODULE W4Od17m2p5t5 ----
\* An airport baggage router finalizes each item's sort through two-phase commit across two participants.
\* An item begins voting; each participant votes yes; once both have voted and the coordinator is among
\* them the item is prepared. Committing a prepared item is irreversible -- it seals the item in the sort
\* ledger and can happen at most once per item, guarded so a sealed item is never sealed again. A
\* privileged admin override may abort a voting or prepared item back to idle, and a committed item may
\* be reset to idle for a new attempt while remaining sealed. Any committed item is one that has been
\* sealed.
EXTENDS Naturals

Items == {"i1", "i2"}
Parts == {"pa", "pb"}

VARIABLES phase, yes, sealed, coord

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Items -> {"idle", "voting", "prepared", "committed"}]
  /\ yes \in [Items -> SUBSET Parts]
  /\ sealed \in SUBSET Items
  /\ coord \in Parts

Init ==
  /\ phase = [i \in Items |-> "idle"]
  /\ yes = [i \in Items |-> {}]
  /\ sealed = {}
  /\ coord = "pa"

Begin(i) ==
  /\ phase[i] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "voting"]
  /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, coord>>

CastYes(i, p) ==
  /\ phase[i] = "voting"
  /\ p \notin yes[i]
  /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = yes[i] \cup {p}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, sealed, coord>>

Prepare(i) ==
  /\ phase[i] = "voting"
  /\ yes[i] = Parts
  /\ coord \in yes[i]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "prepared"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yes, sealed, coord>>

Commit(i) ==
  /\ phase[i] = "prepared"
  /\ i \notin sealed
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "committed"]
  /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {i}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yes, coord>>

AdminAbort(i) ==
  /\ phase[i] \in {"voting", "prepared"}
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
  /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, coord>>

Reset(i) ==
  /\ phase[i] = "committed"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
  /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, coord>>

RotateCoord(p) ==
  /\ coord' = p
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, yes, sealed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Items : Begin(i)
  \/ \E i \in Items, p \in Parts : CastYes(i, p)
  \/ \E i \in Items : Prepare(i)
  \/ \E i \in Items : Commit(i)
  \/ \E i \in Items : AdminAbort(i)
  \/ \E i \in Items : Reset(i)
  \/ \E p \in Parts : RotateCoord(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<phase, yes, sealed, coord>>

CommittedSealed ==
  \A i \in Items : phase[i] = "committed" => i \in sealed
====
nl:
An airport baggage router finalizes each item's sort through two-phase commit across two participants. An idle item begins voting. Each participant casts a yes vote for a voting item. Once both participants have voted yes and the current coordinator is among them, the item is prepared. Committing a prepared item is irreversible: it moves the item to its committed state and seals it in the sort ledger, and it is guarded so that a sealed item is never sealed again. A privileged admin override may abort a voting or prepared item back to idle. A committed item may be reset to idle for a fresh attempt while remaining sealed. The coordinator role may rotate between participants.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any item in the committed state has been sealed in the sort ledger, so the irreversible seal happens at most once per item.

---- MODULE W4Od17m5p0t4 ----
\* An airport baggage router shares one critical sorting arm that must be held exclusively. Control of
\* the arm is granted by quorum voting: three replicas vote for a claimant, and a claimant takes the arm
\* only once a quorum of replicas backs it. While holding the arm the claimant runs sorting lanes up to a
\* capacity that changes at runtime. Releasing the arm clears the votes. Whenever the arm is held, its
\* holder is backed by a quorum of replica votes, so at most one claimant ever controls the critical arm.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Replicas == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
Claimants == {"x1", "x2"}
Quorum == 2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES holder, votes, capacity, used

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Claimants \cup {NONE}
  /\ votes \in [Claimants -> SUBSET Replicas]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ used \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ votes = [x \in Claimants |-> {}]
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ used = 0

Vote(r, x) ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ r \notin votes[x]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![x] = votes[x] \cup {r}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, capacity, used>>

Grant(x) ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ Cardinality(votes[x]) >= Quorum
  /\ holder' = x
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, capacity, used>>

UseLane(x) ==
  /\ holder = x
  /\ used < capacity
  /\ used' = used + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, votes, capacity>>

Release(x) ==
  /\ holder = x
  /\ holder' = NONE
  /\ votes' = [c \in Claimants |-> {}]
  /\ used' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED capacity

AdjustCapacity(c) ==
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, votes, used>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Replicas, x \in Claimants : Vote(r, x)
  \/ \E x \in Claimants : Grant(x)
  \/ \E x \in Claimants : UseLane(x)
  \/ \E x \in Claimants : Release(x)
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, votes, capacity, used>>

HolderHasQuorum ==
  holder # NONE => Cardinality(votes[holder]) >= Quorum
====

An airport baggage router shares one critical sorting arm that must be held exclusively. Control of the arm is granted by quorum voting: three replicas each vote for a claimant while the arm is free. A claimant takes the arm only once a quorum of replicas backs it. While holding the arm, the claimant runs sorting lanes up to a capacity that is adjusted at runtime. Releasing the arm frees it and clears all votes.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the sorting arm is held, its holder is backed by at least a quorum of replica votes, so at most one claimant ever controls the critical arm.

---- MODULE W4Od9m9p1t4 ----
\* A power-grid load shedder keeps one shared setpoint record with a version, updated by operators under
\* epoch-numbered reconfiguration. An operator reads the version and the live epoch; it commits a write
\* only while its read version still equals the live version and its read epoch still equals the live
\* epoch and the change log has room under the buffer capacity, which is adjusted at runtime. A commit
\* advances the version and appends the base version it built on to the change log. A reconfiguration
\* bumps the epoch, invalidating reads taken under the old epoch. Every committed write builds on the
\* version just before it, so the log of base versions is a gap-free chain and no update is lost.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Operators == {"op1", "op2"}
MaxVer == 2
MaxEpoch == 2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES version, wlog, epoch, staged, readEpoch, capacity

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ wlog \in Seq(0..MaxVer)
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ staged \in [Operators -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ readEpoch \in [Operators -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ wlog = << >>
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ staged = [o \in Operators |-> 0]
  /\ readEpoch = [o \in Operators |-> 0]
  /\ capacity = 2

Read(o) ==
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![o] = version]
  /\ readEpoch' = [readEpoch EXCEPT ![o] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, wlog, epoch, capacity>>

Write(o) ==
  /\ staged[o] = version
  /\ readEpoch[o] = epoch
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ Len(wlog) < capacity
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ wlog' = Append(wlog, version)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, staged, readEpoch, capacity>>

Reconfig ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, wlog, staged, readEpoch, capacity>>

AdjustCapacity(c) ==
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, wlog, epoch, staged, readEpoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Operators : Read(o)
  \/ \E o \in Operators : Write(o)
  \/ Reconfig
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<version, wlog, epoch, staged, readEpoch, capacity>>

ContiguousLog ==
  \A k \in 1..Len(wlog) : wlog[k] = k - 1
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder keeps one shared setpoint record with a version number, updated by operators under epoch-numbered reconfiguration. An operator reads the current version and the live epoch into its staged view. It commits a write only while its staged version still equals the live version, its staged epoch still equals the live epoch, and the change log has room under the buffer capacity, which is adjusted at runtime. A commit advances the version by one and appends the base version it built upon to the change log. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, invalidating any read taken under the previous epoch.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The log of base versions on which committed writes were built is a gap-free chain 0,1,2,..., so no update overwrites a concurrent one and none is lost.

---- MODULE W4Od18m6p3t2 ----
\* A smart-home door-lock network is managed by two controller instances that share one pool of doors,
\* leasing exclusive control under time-limited leases. A controller first reserves a free door, then
\* acquires it, taking the door out of the free set, recording itself as the lease holder, and charging
\* the lease to full span. A lease may be renewed, released back to the free set, or decayed one step at
\* a time until it lapses and returns the door. The free-door set and the lease holders are kept
\* coherent: a door is free exactly when it has no lease holder, so a door under a live lease is never
\* handed to a second controller.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Doors == {"g1", "g2"}
Instances == {"a", "b"}
Span == 2

VARIABLES leaseHolder, freeDoors, ttl, reservedBy

TypeOK ==
  /\ leaseHolder \in [Doors -> Instances \cup {NONE}]
  /\ freeDoors \in SUBSET Doors
  /\ ttl \in [Doors -> 0..Span]
  /\ reservedBy \in [Doors -> Instances \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ leaseHolder = [g \in Doors |-> NONE]
  /\ freeDoors = Doors
  /\ ttl = [g \in Doors |-> 0]
  /\ reservedBy = [g \in Doors |-> NONE]

Reserve(i, g) ==
  /\ g \in freeDoors
  /\ reservedBy[g] = NONE
  /\ reservedBy' = [reservedBy EXCEPT ![g] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, freeDoors, ttl>>

Acquire(i, g) ==
  /\ g \in freeDoors
  /\ reservedBy[g] = i
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![g] = i]
  /\ freeDoors' = freeDoors \ {g}
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = Span]
  /\ reservedBy' = [reservedBy EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]

Renew(i, g) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[g] = i
  /\ ttl[g] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, freeDoors, reservedBy>>

Release(i, g) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[g] = i
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
  /\ freeDoors' = freeDoors \cup {g}
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED reservedBy

Decay(g) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[g] # NONE
  /\ ttl[g] > 1
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = ttl[g] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, freeDoors, reservedBy>>

Lapse(g) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[g] # NONE
  /\ ttl[g] = 1
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
  /\ freeDoors' = freeDoors \cup {g}
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED reservedBy

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, g \in Doors : Reserve(i, g)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, g \in Doors : Acquire(i, g)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, g \in Doors : Renew(i, g)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, g \in Doors : Release(i, g)
  \/ \E g \in Doors : Decay(g)
  \/ \E g \in Doors : Lapse(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leaseHolder, freeDoors, ttl, reservedBy>>

FreeCoherent ==
  \A g \in Doors : (g \in freeDoors) <=> (leaseHolder[g] = NONE)
====
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network is managed by two controller instances that share one pool of doors, leasing exclusive control under time-limited leases. A controller first reserves a free, unreserved door, then acquires it, which removes the door from the free set, records the controller as its lease holder, charges the lease to full span, and clears the reservation. A lease may be renewed to full span or released back into the free set. A lease decays a step at a time and, at its last tick, lapses and returns the door to the free set. The free-door set and the lease holders are kept coherent as doors are taken and returned.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A door is in the free set exactly when it has no lease holder, so a door under a live lease is never handed to a second controller.

---- MODULE W4Od2m6p4t2 ----
\* A warehouse robot fleet is directed by two controller instances that share one robot pool, leasing
\* robots to work stations under time-limited leases. Each station has a capacity, adjusted at runtime
\* but never below the number of robots already leased to it. Leasing a free robot to a station is
\* admitted only while that station's current robot count is below its capacity; it stamps the leasing
\* instance and charges the lease to full span. A lease may be renewed, released, or decayed until it
\* lapses and returns the robot. The number of robots leased to any station never exceeds its capacity.

NONE == "none"
Robots == {"d1", "d2"}
Stations == {"st1", "st2"}
Instances == {"a", "b"}
MaxCap == 2
Span == 2

  /\ cap \in [Stations -> 0..MaxCap]
  /\ leasedBy \in [Robots -> Instances \cup {NONE}]

  /\ station = [d \in Robots |-> NONE]
  /\ ttl = [d \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ cap = [s \in Stations |-> 1]
  /\ leasedBy = [d \in Robots |-> NONE]

Load(s) == Cardinality({d \in Robots : station[d] = s})

  /\ Load(s) < cap[s]
  /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![d] = s]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![d] = Span]
  /\ leasedBy' = [leasedBy EXCEPT ![d] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED cap

Renew(i, d) ==
  /\ leasedBy[d] = i
  /\ ttl[d] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![d] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<station, cap, leasedBy>>

Release(i, d) ==
  /\ leasedBy[d] = i
  /\ station' = [station EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![d] = 0]
  /\ leasedBy' = [leasedBy EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED cap

Decay(d) ==
  /\ station[d] # NONE
  /\ ttl[d] > 1
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![d] = ttl[d] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<station, cap, leasedBy>>

Lapse(d) ==

  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![d] = 0]
  /\ leasedBy' = [leasedBy EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]

  /\ c >= Load(s)
  /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![s] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<station, ttl, leasedBy>>

  \/ \E i \in Instances, d \in Robots : Renew(i, d)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, d \in Robots : Release(i, d)
  \/ \E d \in Robots : Decay(d)
  \/ \E d \in Robots : Lapse(d)
  \/ \E s \in Stations, c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCap(s, c)

---- MODULE W4Od17m0p6t4 ----
\* An airport baggage router commits sort actions through optimistic locking against a shared action
\* counter. A handler reads the counter, then commits an action only while it is currently authorized,
\* its read still matches the live counter, and the counter is below the runtime-adjustable action
\* capacity; committing advances the counter and records the handler as the last actor. Authorizing
\* adds a handler; revoking removes a handler and, if it was the last actor, clears that record so no
\* revoked handler leaves a standing effect. The last actor, whenever set, is always a currently
\* authorized handler -- no unauthorized or stale participant is ever left in control.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Handlers == {"h1", "h2"}
MaxCnt == 2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES authorized, counter, staged, lastActor, capacity

TypeOK ==
  /\ authorized \in SUBSET Handlers
  /\ counter \in 0..MaxCnt
  /\ staged \in [Handlers -> 0..MaxCnt]
  /\ lastActor \in Handlers \cup {NONE}
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ authorized = Handlers
  /\ counter = 0
  /\ staged = [h \in Handlers |-> 0]
  /\ lastActor = NONE
  /\ capacity = 2

Read(h) ==
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![h] = counter]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, counter, lastActor, capacity>>

Act(h) ==
  /\ h \in authorized
  /\ staged[h] = counter
  /\ counter < capacity
  /\ counter < MaxCnt
  /\ counter' = counter + 1
  /\ lastActor' = h
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, staged, capacity>>

Revoke(h) ==
  /\ h \in authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \ {h}
  /\ lastActor' = IF lastActor = h THEN NONE ELSE lastActor
  /\ UNCHANGED <<counter, staged, capacity>>

Grant(h) ==
  /\ h \notin authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {h}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<counter, staged, lastActor, capacity>>

AdjustCapacity(c) ==
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, counter, staged, lastActor>>

Next ==
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : Read(h)
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : Act(h)
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : Revoke(h)
  \/ \E h \in Handlers : Grant(h)
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<authorized, counter, staged, lastActor, capacity>>

ActorAuthorized ==
  lastActor # NONE => lastActor \in authorized
====

An airport baggage router commits sort actions through optimistic locking against a shared action counter. A handler reads the counter into its staged view. Revoking removes a handler and, if that handler was the recorded last actor, clears the last-actor record so a revoked handler leaves no standing effect.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a last actor is recorded, it is a currently authorized handler, so no unauthorized or stale participant is ever left in control.

---- MODULE W4Od11m6p0t3 ----
\* A print shop job spooler grants exclusive use of one printer to jobs under a time-limited lease.
\* A job first queues for the printer; it may be slow but not failed, waiting while others proceed.
\* Acquiring while the printer is free makes the job the owner, sets its local lease-held flag, and
\* charges the lease to full span. The lease may be renewed, released, or decayed until it lapses and
\* frees the printer. A job's lease-held flag is set only while it is the recorded owner of the printer,
\* so at most one job ever holds the printer at a time.
EXTENDS Naturals

Jobs == {"j1", "j2"}
Span == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Jobs \cup {NONE}

  /\ ttl \in 0..Span
  /\ queued \in SUBSET Jobs

  /\ owner = NONE
  /\ leaseHeld = [j \in Jobs |-> FALSE]
  /\ ttl = 0
  /\ queued = {}

Request(j) ==

  /\ j \notin queued
  /\ queued' = queued \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseHeld, ttl>>

Acquire(j) ==
  /\ owner = NONE
  /\ j \in queued
  /\ owner' = j
  /\ leaseHeld' = [leaseHeld EXCEPT ![j] = TRUE]
  /\ ttl' = Span
  /\ queued' = queued \ {j}

Renew(j) ==
  /\ owner = j
  /\ ttl > 0
  /\ ttl' = Span
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseHeld, queued>>

Decay ==
  /\ owner # NONE
  /\ ttl > 1
  /\ ttl' = ttl - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseHeld, queued>>

Expire ==
  /\ owner # NONE
  /\ ttl = 1
  /\ leaseHeld' = [leaseHeld EXCEPT ![owner] = FALSE]
  /\ owner' = NONE
  /\ ttl' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED queued

Release(j) ==
  /\ owner = j
  /\ leaseHeld' = [leaseHeld EXCEPT ![j] = FALSE]
  /\ owner' = NONE
  /\ ttl' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED queued

Next ==
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Request(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Acquire(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Renew(j)
  \/ Decay
  \/ Expire
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Release(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<owner, leaseHeld, ttl, queued>>

LeaseExclusive ==
  \A j \in Jobs : leaseHeld[j] => owner = j

nl:
A print shop job spooler grants exclusive use of one printer to jobs under a time-limited lease. A job first queues for the printer; a job may be slow but not failed, waiting in the queue while other jobs proceed. Acquiring the printer while it is free removes the job from the queue, makes it the owner, sets its local lease-held flag, and charges the lease to full span. The owner may renew the lease to full span or release the printer. The lease decays a step at a time and, at its last tick, lapses and frees the printer, clearing the owner's lease-held flag.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A job's lease-held flag is set only while that job is the recorded owner of the printer, so at most one job ever holds the printer at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od1m2p6t4 ----
\* An air-traffic runway allocator finalizes runway assignments through two-phase commit driven by air
\* traffic controllers. Only a currently authorized controller may prepare a transaction, becoming its
\* recorded committer; the same authorized controller commits it, consuming a runway slot up to a
\* runtime-adjustable capacity. A transaction may be aborted or, once committed, finished for reuse.
\* Revoking a controller drops it from the authorized set and, if it was the recorded committer of a
\* not-yet-committed transaction, clears that record and resets the transaction. The recorded committer,
\* whenever set, is always a currently authorized controller -- no unauthorized participant drives a commit.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Controllers == {"ct1", "ct2"}
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES phase, authorized, committer, capacity, used

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "prepared", "committed"}
  /\ authorized \in SUBSET Controllers
  /\ committer \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ used \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ authorized = Controllers
  /\ committer = NONE
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ used = 0

Prepare(c) ==
  /\ c \in authorized
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ phase' = "prepared"
  /\ committer' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, capacity, used>>

Commit(c) ==
  /\ c \in authorized
  /\ phase = "prepared"
  /\ committer = c
  /\ used < capacity
  /\ phase' = "committed"
  /\ used' = used + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, committer, capacity>>

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "prepared"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ committer' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, capacity, used>>

Finish ==
  /\ phase = "committed"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ committer' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, capacity, used>>

Revoke(c) ==
  /\ c \in authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \ {c}
  /\ committer' = IF committer = c THEN NONE ELSE committer
  /\ phase' = IF committer = c /\ phase = "prepared" THEN "idle" ELSE phase
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, used>>

Grant(c) ==
  /\ c \notin authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, committer, capacity, used>>

AdjustCapacity(k) ==
  /\ capacity' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, authorized, committer, used>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Prepare(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
  \/ Abort
  \/ Finish
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Revoke(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Grant(c)
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<phase, authorized, committer, capacity, used>>

CommitterAuthorized ==
  committer # NONE => committer \in authorized
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator finalizes runway assignments through two-phase commit driven by air traffic controllers. Only a currently authorized controller may prepare a transaction, becoming its recorded committer. That same authorized controller commits the prepared transaction, consuming one runway slot while the number used is below the runtime-adjustable capacity. A prepared transaction may be aborted back to idle, and a committed transaction may be finished for reuse. Revoking a controller removes it from the authorized set and, if it was the recorded committer of a transaction not yet committed, clears that record and resets the transaction to idle. A revoked controller may later be granted again, and the capacity may be adjusted at runtime.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a committer is recorded, it is a currently authorized controller, so no unauthorized participant ever drives a commit.

---- MODULE W4Od1m5p1t3 ----
\* An air-traffic runway allocator commits updates to one shared schedule value through quorum voting.
\* A proposal offers a new value and collects acknowledgements from three acceptors, which may be slow
\* but not failed and so ack at their own pace. The update commits only once a quorum of acceptors has
\* acknowledged, at which point it stores the value, advances the version, and appends the value to the
\* change history; an in-flight proposal may instead be cancelled. The stored value always equals the
\* most recently committed value in the history, so no acknowledged update is lost to a blind overwrite.
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

Acceptors == {"a1", "a2", "a3"}
Quorum == 2
MaxVer == 2
Vals == {0, 1}

VARIABLES value, version, hist, proposing, propVal, acks

TypeOK ==
  /\ value \in Vals
  /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ hist \in Seq(Vals)
  /\ proposing \in BOOLEAN
  /\ propVal \in Vals
  /\ acks \in SUBSET Acceptors

Init ==
  /\ value = 0
  /\ version = 0
  /\ hist = << >>
  /\ proposing = FALSE
  /\ propVal = 0
  /\ acks = {}

Propose(v) ==
  /\ ~proposing
  /\ proposing' = TRUE
  /\ propVal' = v
  /\ acks' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, hist>>

Ack(a) ==
  /\ proposing
  /\ a \notin acks
  /\ acks' = acks \cup {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, hist, proposing, propVal>>

Commit ==
  /\ proposing
  /\ Cardinality(acks) >= Quorum
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ value' = propVal
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ hist' = Append(hist, propVal)
  /\ proposing' = FALSE
  /\ acks' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED propVal

Cancel ==
  /\ proposing
  /\ proposing' = FALSE
  /\ acks' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, hist, propVal>>

Next ==
  \/ \E v \in Vals : Propose(v)
  \/ \E a \in Acceptors : Ack(a)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Cancel

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<value, version, hist, proposing, propVal, acks>>

ValueMatchesHistory ==
  IF hist = << >> THEN value = 0 ELSE value = hist[Len(hist)]
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator commits updates to one shared schedule value through quorum voting. A proposal offers a new value and collects acknowledgements from three acceptors; an acceptor may be slow but not failed, so it acknowledges at its own pace. The update commits only once a quorum of acceptors has acknowledged, at which point it stores the value, advances the version by one, and appends the value to the change history. An in-flight proposal may instead be cancelled, discarding its acknowledgements.

---- MODULE W4Od14m3p3t1 ----
\* A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns a drone to fire zones under a single elected leader, with
\* leader election and failover across terms. Starting a term clears the leader and votes; a node is
\* elected once both nodes vote for it; the leader crashes on failover. Assignment requests may arrive
\* reordered and wait in a small unordered pool. The leader assigns the drone to a free zone, recording
\* the zone's drone and marking the zone taken; releasing frees the zone. A zone is marked taken exactly
\* when it holds the drone, so a free zone is only ever assigned once and never double-allocated.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Drones == {"d1"}
MaxTerm == 2
PoolCap == 2

VARIABLES zoneDrone, taken, leader, votedFor, term, pool

Req == [zone: Zones, drone: Drones]

TypeOK ==
  /\ zoneDrone \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
  /\ taken \in [Zones -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
  /\ votedFor \in [Nodes -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ pool \in SUBSET Req

Init ==
  /\ zoneDrone = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
  /\ taken = [z \in Zones |-> FALSE]
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ votedFor = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
  /\ term = 0
  /\ pool = {}

StartTerm ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ leader' = NONE
  /\ votedFor' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, pool>>

Vote(n, cand) ==
  /\ votedFor[n] = NONE
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = cand]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, leader, term, pool>>

Elect(cand) ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : votedFor[n] = cand
  /\ leader' = cand
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, votedFor, term, pool>>

Crash(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ leader' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, votedFor, term, pool>>

ClearVotes ==
  /\ leader = NONE
  /\ \E n \in Nodes : votedFor[n] # NONE
  /\ votedFor' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, leader, term, pool>>

Submit(z, d) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pool) < PoolCap
  /\ pool' = pool \cup {[zone |-> z, drone |-> d]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneDrone, taken, leader, votedFor, term>>

Assign(m) ==
  /\ leader # NONE
  /\ m \in pool
  /\ zoneDrone[m.zone] = NONE
  /\ ~taken[m.zone]
  /\ ~\E z \in Zones : zoneDrone[z] = m.drone
  /\ zoneDrone' = [zoneDrone EXCEPT ![m.zone] = m.drone]
  /\ taken' = [taken EXCEPT ![m.zone] = TRUE]
  /\ pool' = pool \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, votedFor, term>>

Release(z) ==
  /\ zoneDrone[z] # NONE
  /\ zoneDrone' = [zoneDrone EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
  /\ taken' = [taken EXCEPT ![z] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, votedFor, term, pool>>

Next ==
  \/ StartTerm
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, cand \in Nodes : Vote(n, cand)
  \/ \E cand \in Nodes : Elect(cand)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
  \/ ClearVotes
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones : Submit(z, d)
  \/ \E m \in pool : Assign(m)
  \/ \E z \in Zones : Release(z)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<zoneDrone, taken, leader, votedFor, term, pool>>

TakenCoherent ==
  \A z \in Zones : taken[z] <=> (zoneDrone[z] # NONE)
====

A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns a drone to fire zones under a single elected leader, using leader election with failover across terms. Starting a term increments the term and clears the leader and votes; each node votes once per term while there is no leader; a node is elected once both nodes vote for it; and the leader crashes on failover. When an election stalls, the votes may be cleared to retry. Assignment requests may arrive reordered and wait in a small unordered pool. The leader assigns the drone to a free zone, recording the zone's drone and marking the zone taken; releasing frees the zone.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A zone is marked taken exactly when it holds the drone, so a free zone is only ever assigned once and never double-allocated.

---- MODULE W4Od0m9p0t3 ----
\* A hospital operating-room scheduler shares one critical theatre resource under epoch-numbered
\* reconfiguration. A scheduler observes the live epoch into its own view; it may be slow but not
\* failed, so its view can lag. It may seize the free theatre only while its observed epoch still equals
\* the live epoch, becoming the holder and stamping the epoch it seized under. Releasing frees the
\* theatre. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, frees the theatre, and re-stamps the holder epoch, so a
\* stale holder cannot linger. Whenever the theatre is held, it was seized under the current epoch, so
\* at most one scheduler occupies the critical theatre.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Schedulers == {"s1", "s2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, holder, holderEpoch, seen

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ holder \in Schedulers \cup {NONE}
  /\ holderEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ seen \in [Schedulers -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ holderEpoch = 0
  /\ seen = [s \in Schedulers |-> 0]

Observe(s) ==
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, holderEpoch>>

Seize(s) ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ seen[s] = epoch
  /\ holder' = s
  /\ holderEpoch' = epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seen>>

Release(s) ==
  /\ holder = s
  /\ holder' = NONE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holderEpoch, seen>>

Reconfig ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ holder' = NONE
  /\ holderEpoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED seen

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Observe(s)
  \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Seize(s)
  \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Release(s)
  \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<epoch, holder, holderEpoch, seen>>

HolderCurrentEpoch ==
  holder # NONE => holderEpoch = epoch
====

A hospital operating-room scheduler shares one critical theatre resource under epoch-numbered reconfiguration. It may seize the theatre only while the theatre is free and its observed epoch still equals the live epoch, becoming the holder and stamping the epoch it seized under. Releasing frees the theatre. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, frees the theatre, and re-stamps the holder epoch, so a stale holder cannot linger past a reconfiguration.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the theatre is held, it was seized under the current epoch, so at most one scheduler occupies the critical theatre at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od18m6p3t3 ----
\* A smart-home door-lock network leases doors from a shared pool that offers free doors for lease.
\* A controller announces intent for a door, then leases it while the door is offered and free, which
\* takes the door out of the offer set, records the controller as owner, and charges the lease to full
\* span. A controller may be slow but not failed, holding its intent while others proceed. A lease may
\* be renewed, released, or decayed until it lapses. A door that currently has an owner is never also in
\* the offer set, so a door under a live lease is never offered for a second lease and double-allocated.
EXTENDS Naturals

NONE == "none"
Doors == {"g1", "g2"}
Controllers == {"a", "b"}
Span == 2

VARIABLES owner, offered, ttl, intent

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in [Doors -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
  /\ offered \in SUBSET Doors
  /\ ttl \in [Doors -> 0..Span]
  /\ intent \in [Controllers -> Doors \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
  /\ owner = [g \in Doors |-> NONE]
  /\ offered = {}
  /\ ttl = [g \in Doors |-> 0]
  /\ intent = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]

Offer(g) ==
  /\ owner[g] = NONE
  /\ g \notin offered
  /\ offered' = offered \cup {g}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ttl, intent>>

Intend(c, g) ==
  /\ intent[c] = NONE
  /\ intent' = [intent EXCEPT ![c] = g]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, offered, ttl>>

Lease(c, g) ==
  /\ g \in offered
  /\ owner[g] = NONE
  /\ intent[c] = g
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![g] = c]
  /\ offered' = offered \ {g}
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = Span]
  /\ intent' = [intent EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]

Renew(c, g) ==
  /\ owner[g] = c
  /\ ttl[g] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, offered, intent>>

Release(c, g) ==
  /\ owner[g] = c
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<offered, intent>>

Decay(g) ==
  /\ owner[g] # NONE
  /\ ttl[g] > 1
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = ttl[g] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, offered, intent>>

Lapse(g) ==
  /\ owner[g] # NONE
  /\ ttl[g] = 1
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![g] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<offered, intent>>

Next ==
  \/ \E g \in Doors : Offer(g)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Doors : Intend(c, g)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Doors : Lease(c, g)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Doors : Renew(c, g)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, g \in Doors : Release(c, g)
  \/ \E g \in Doors : Decay(g)
  \/ \E g \in Doors : Lapse(g)

  \A g \in Doors : owner[g] # NONE => g \notin offered

A smart-home door-lock network leases doors from a shared pool that offers free doors for lease. A door with no owner may be placed into the offer set.   /\ capacity = 1

  /\ deployed = {}

\* and decays until it lapses and frees the car, clearing any stale last-actor stamp. A command names a
\* car and a controller; it is acted on only when that controller currently holds the car's lease,
\* stamping it as the car's last actor, and a command from a non-holder is dropped. Whenever a car has a
\* last actor, that actor currently holds the car's lease -- no unauthorized or stale controller acts.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Cars == {"c1", "c2"}
Controllers == {"o1", "o2"}
Span == 2
PoolCap == 2

VARIABLES leaseHolder, ttl, actor, inbox

Cmd == [car: Cars, ctrl: Controllers]

TypeOK ==
  /\ leaseHolder \in [Cars -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
  /\ ttl \in [Cars -> 0..Span]
  /\ actor \in [Cars -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
  /\ inbox \in SUBSET Cmd

Init ==
  /\ leaseHolder = [c \in Cars |-> NONE]
  /\ ttl = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
  /\ actor = [c \in Cars |-> NONE]
  /\ inbox = {}

Lease(o, c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] = NONE
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![c] = o]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<actor, inbox>>

Renew(o, c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] = o
  /\ ttl[c] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, actor, inbox>>

Decay(c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] # NONE
  /\ ttl[c] > 1
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = ttl[c] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, actor, inbox>>

Lapse(c) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[c] # NONE
  /\ ttl[c] = 1
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
  /\ actor' = [actor EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED inbox

Submit(o, c) ==
  /\ Cardinality(inbox) < PoolCap
  /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[car |-> c, ctrl |-> o]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, ttl, actor>>

Act(m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ leaseHolder[m.car] = m.ctrl
  /\ actor' = [actor EXCEPT ![m.car] = m.ctrl]
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, ttl>>

DropCmd(m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ leaseHolder[m.car] # m.ctrl
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, ttl, actor>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Lease(o, c)
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Renew(o, c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Decay(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Lapse(c)
  \/ \E o \in Controllers, c \in Cars : Submit(o, c)
  \/ \E m \in inbox : Act(m)
  \/ \E m \in inbox : DropCmd(m)

ActorHoldsLease ==
  \A c \in Cars : actor[c] # NONE => leaseHolder[c] = actor[c]

A free car may be leased to a controller and the lease charged to full span; the lease may be renewed, decays a step at a time, and at its last tick lapses to free the car and clear any last-actor stamp on it. \* A pharmacy prescription dispenser grants exclusive control of one critical dispensing lock through
\* quorum voting. Three voters back a claimant while the lock is free; a voter may crash silently and
\* then casts no votes until it recovers. A claimant takes the lock only once a quorum of voters backs
\* it, and while holding the lock it dispenses up to a bounded number of doses. Releasing the lock clears
\* the votes. Whenever the lock is held, its holder is backed by a quorum of votes, so at most one
\* claimant ever controls the critical dispensing lock.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

NONE == "none"
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Claimants == {"y1", "y2"}
Quorum == 2
MaxDose == 2

VARIABLES holder, votes, crashed, dispensed

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Claimants \cup {NONE}
  /\ votes \in [Claimants -> SUBSET Voters]
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Voters
  /\ dispensed \in 0..MaxDose

Init ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ votes = [y \in Claimants |-> {}]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ dispensed = 0

CastVote(v, y) ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ v \notin crashed
  /\ v \notin votes[y]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![y] = votes[y] \cup {v}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, crashed, dispensed>>

Grant(y) ==
  /\ holder = NONE
  /\ Cardinality(votes[y]) >= Quorum
  /\ holder' = y
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed, dispensed>>

Dispense(y) ==
  /\ holder = y
  /\ dispensed < MaxDose
  /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, votes, crashed>>

Release(y) ==
  /\ holder = y
  /\ holder' = NONE
  /\ votes' = [c \in Claimants |-> {}]
  /\ dispensed' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(v) ==
  /\ v \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {v}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, votes, dispensed>>

Recover(v) ==
  /\ v \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {v}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, votes, dispensed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E v \in Voters, y \in Claimants : CastVote(v, y)
  \/ \E y \in Claimants : Grant(y)
  \/ \E y \in Claimants : Dispense(y)
  \/ \E y \in Claimants : Release(y)
  \/ \E v \in Voters : Crash(v)
  \/ \E v \in Voters : Recover(v)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, votes, crashed, dispensed>>

HolderQuorumBacked ==
  holder # NONE => Cardinality(votes[holder]) >= Quorum
====

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the dispensing lock is held, its holder is backed by at least a quorum of votes, so at most one claimant ever controls the critical lock.
